pages.title: Soul Lantern
pages.text: Turns your own max health into $(6)Soul Gems$(). Only a Branded player can use it.

pages.title: Harvesting a Soul Gem
pages.text: $(l)Right-click$() with the lantern to permanently lose $(c)1 max HP$() and get $(6)1 Soul Gem$(). It won't work if your max health is too low.$(br2)Soul Gems upgrade a Titan's Remnant from Transcendent to Apex.
